sol-2-1.summary: PortableTsconfig accepts compiler options that violate its portable invariants.
sol-2-1.fix: Define an identity-annotated nested options schema from the preserved CompilerOptions fields, optional types, and required noEmit: S.Literal(true) / composite: S.Literal(false). Exclude nonportable fields from decoded and encoded output while retaining make as the upstream projection. Add boundary assertions for missing/reversed flags and exclusion of outDir/typeRoots; adapt the schema-derived round-trip and projection properties to the precise shape without weakening them.

fable-2-1.summary: Encoding an unmappable enum string now throws instead of preserving the upstream value.
fable-2-1.fix: Restore const encoded = encode(family, value) and update result[key] only when O.isSome(encoded), preserving the original copied string on None. Retain the diagnostic/law-forced schema-derived types, Effect imports, and lookup collections. Restore any upstream test lines rewritten for this unforced change and add a passthrough regression using the existing deliberatelyInvalid helper; this S3 diff did not rewrite the upstream TsEnumCodec.test.ts.

fable-2-2.summary: Encoding a non-string lib entry now throws instead of passing it through.
fable-2-2.fix: Restore the upstream source.lib read and guarded mapping: normalize and wrap only P.isString entries, passing other entries through unchanged. Keep the cast-free result construction and law-forced public types. Restore any upstream test lines rewritten for this unforced change and add a mixed string/non-string regression through deliberatelyInvalid in TsEnumCodec.test.ts; the S3 diff did not rewrite that upstream test file.

fable-2-3.summary: Compiler-option path transformations lost upstream element and paths-value guards.
fable-2-3.fix: Restore the upstream per-entry P.isString checks for typeRoots/rootDirs and restore A.isArray plus per-entry P.isString inside the paths rebuildRecord callback. Preserve non-string/non-array values unchanged and retain law/diagnostic-forced cast-free copies and Effect helpers. Restore any rewritten upstream test lines and add focused regressions covering both public transforms in ResolvedTsconfig.test.ts using the existing deliberatelyInvalid helper; S3 did not rewrite that upstream test file.

fable-2-4.summary: Watch-exclude substitution lost upstream non-string passthrough.
fable-2-4.fix: Restore value.map(entry => P.isString(entry) ? substitute(entry) : entry) for both watch exclude lists. Retain cast-free typed copies, current representation and Effect helpers. Restore any rewritten upstream test lines and add mixed string/non-string watch-exclude regressions in ResolvedTsconfig.test.ts via deliberatelyInvalid; S3 did not rewrite that upstream test file.
